title: wavelet
body:
## wavelet

Creates a synthetic uniform image (vtkImageData) whose point array RTData combines a Gaussian peak of height maximum with sinusoidal terms along x, y and z. With the Schemaxis defaults it is a 21 x 21 x 21-point grid with unit spacing spanning -10 to 10 on each axis. Use it as a self-contained input to try slice, contour, clip, streamTracer or scene settings without a real case; its values have no physical meaning or units.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each extent minimum must be smaller than its maximum, so the curated wavelet cannot produce a 2-D image; use pvWavelet for planar or subsampled images and to change frequencies, amplitudes or the Gaussian width.
- RTData is a scalar; derive test vectors with calculator (e.g. iHat), as the native acceptance example examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json does before its analytic integral checks.

Native constructor: `Wavelet`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `extent` | The six values in this property indicate the X, Y, and Z extent of the output data. The first two values represent the minimum and maximum X indices, the next two are the minimum and maximum Y indices, and the last two are the minimum and maximum Z indices. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer"},"minItems":6,"maxItems":6}` | `[-10,10,-10,10,-10,10]` | `[-10,10,-10,10,-10,10]` |
| `centre` | Centre of the Gaussian and origin of the wave coordinates, in grid-index units: for each point, x, y and z are the offsets of its grid index from Center, divided by the extent width on that axis, and the Gaussian depends on their length r. It is not in physical units. ParaView's own text refers to "the equation" it prints, which multiplies the terms; the filter adds them to the Gaussian. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `maximum` | Height of the Gaussian term of RTData at centre. It is not the maximum of the output: sine and cosine terms (ParaView amplitudes 10, 18 and 5) are added to it, so RTData can exceed it. Raising it strengthens the central peak relative to the ripples. | `{"type":"number"}` | `255` | `255` |

Cross-option checks:

```json
[
  {
    "kind": "bounds",
    "option": "extent"
  }
]
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "wavelet"
}
```
